decision.observation: Speed 8 mph, gear 1, car centred on the lane with barrels along both verges. Ahead the lit lane runs up-screen and bends right past a grey boulder on its left and a blue puddle on its right, with pines closing in; all dots dark, no red X. Timer 37:33.
decision.hypothesis: The car is carrying speed and tracking well, but the bend ahead is to the right and the verge barrels are close on that side, so a short right-steered throttle now should follow the bend rather than letting plain throttle run wide into the left verge.
decision.memory: At 8+ mph steering corrections need to stay short (~0.4s) or the car overshoots into the barrels. This barrel-lined bend matches the earlier 'bending right past a boulder and puddles' stretch.
